t: 阿拉斯联盟将荷兰南部统一为帕尔马公爵(英语:Ottavio Farnese)所辖,以西班牙国王…
te: The Union of Arras unites the southern Netherlands under the Duke of Parma (Ottavio Farnese), governor in the name of K…
dz: 阿拉斯联盟将荷兰南部统一为帕尔马公爵(英语:Ottavio Farnese)所辖,以西班牙国王腓力二世为名的总督.
de: The Union of Arras unites the southern Netherlands under the Duke of Parma (Ottavio Farnese), governor in the name of King Philip II of Spain.

t: 乌得勒支联邦在荷兰形成新教共和国.
te: The Union of Utrecht forms a Protestant republic in the Netherlands.
dz: 乌得勒支联邦在荷兰形成新教共和国.
de: The Union of Utrecht forms a Protestant republic in the Netherlands.

t: 马尼拉主教座堂由教宗公牛所建,多明戈·德·萨拉扎任命其为首任主教.
te: The Diocese of Manila is erected by papal bull, with Domingo de Salazar appointed its first bishop.
dz: 马尼拉主教座堂由教宗公牛所建,多明戈·德·萨拉扎任命其为首任主教.
de: The Diocese of Manila is erected by papal bull, with Domingo de Salazar appointed its first bishop.

t: 开始围攻马斯特里赫特 八十年战争的一部分.
te: Start of the Siege of Maastricht, part of the Eighty Years' War.
dz: 开始围攻马斯特里赫特 八十年战争的一部分.
de: Start of the Siege of Maastricht, part of the Eighty Years' War.

t: 弗朗西斯·德雷克 (Francis Drake) 爵士声称英格兰拥有一块他称之为新阿尔比恩 (…
te: Sir Francis Drake claims a land he calls Nova Albion (modern California) for England.
dz: 弗朗西斯·德雷克 (Francis Drake) 爵士声称英格兰拥有一块他称之为新阿尔比恩 (Nova Albion)（现代加利福尼亚州）的土地。
de: Sir Francis Drake claims a land he calls Nova Albion (modern California) for England.

t: 斯蒂芬·巴托里(Stephen Báthory)的利沃尼亚运动开始.
te: Livonian campaign of Stephen Báthory begins.
dz: 斯蒂芬·巴托里(Stephen Báthory)的利沃尼亚运动开始.
de: Livonian campaign of Stephen Báthory begins.

t: 喀山圣母会是俄罗斯正教会的圣像,在鞑靼斯坦喀山市地下出土.
te: Our Lady of Kazan, a holy icon of the Russian Orthodox Church, is discovered underground in the city of Kazan, Tatarsta…
dz: 喀山圣母会是俄罗斯正教会的圣像,在鞑靼斯坦喀山市地下出土.
de: Our Lady of Kazan, a holy icon of the Russian Orthodox Church, is discovered underground in the city of Kazan, Tatarstan.

t: 英国探险家弗朗西斯·德雷克在太平洋西北海岸（可能是俄勒冈州或华盛顿州）发现了一个“公平而美好”…
te: Francis Drake, the English explorer, discovers a "fair and good" bay on the coast of the Pacific Northwest (probably Or…
dz: 英国探险家弗朗西斯·德雷克在太平洋西北海岸（可能是俄勒冈州或华盛顿州）发现了一个“公平而美好”的海湾。
de: Francis Drake, the English explorer, discovers a "fair and good" bay on the coast of the Pacific Northwest (probably Oregon or Washington).

t: 苏格兰的詹姆斯六世被爱丁堡的一个节日庆祝为成人统治者.
te: James VI of Scotland is celebrated as an adult ruler by a festival in Edinburgh.
dz: 苏格兰的詹姆斯六世被爱丁堡的一个节日庆祝为成人统治者.
de: James VI of Scotland is celebrated as an adult ruler by a festival in Edinburgh.
